newsitem.title: USA: National Surgery Centers buys Okla. unit.
newsitem.headline: National Surgery Centers buys Okla. unit.

text.p: National Surgery Centers Inc said Monday it has acquired Surgery Center of South Oklahoma City in Oklahoma City, Okla. from a group of physicians.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
National Surgery Centers said it expects the acquisition will immediately add to earnings.

This is the company's second center in the greater Oklahoma City area. With four operating rooms and one treatment room, the center's annual volume now totals about 4,000 cases which account for about $6 million in annual net revenue.

In 1996, National Surgery Centers reported total case volume of 84,970 cases and net revenue of $77.4 million. Separately, National Surgery Centers said its Physicians Surgical Center in Norman, Okla. recently entered into a joint venture agreement with Norman Regional Hospital.
National Surgery Centers, the largest independent operator of freestanding ambulatory surgery centers in the country, has 34 outpatient centers located in 12 states.
